scripts.reset: npm -w @relay/api run migrate && npm -w @relay/api run seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,console,rider,driver -c gray,magenta,yellow,green "npm -w @relay/api run dev" "npm -w @relay/web run dev" "npm -w @relay/rider run dev" "npm -w @relay/driver run dev"
scripts.build: npm -w @relay/web run build && npm -w @relay/rider run build && npm -w @relay/driver run build
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/contracts && tsc -p packages/ui && tsc -p apps/api --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web --noEmit && tsc -p apps/rider --noEmit && tsc -p apps/driver --noEmit
scripts.build:prod: VITE_BASE=/rider/ npm -w @relay/rider run build && VITE_BASE=/driver/ npm -w @relay/driver run build && VITE_BASE=/console/ npm -w @relay/web run build
scripts.start:prod: npm -w @relay/api run bootstrap && npm -w @relay/api run start
